g.text: Not released for fabrication; see design review and validation reports

g.desc: Not released for fabrication; see design review and validation reports

g.text: Firmware must keep motors disabled at boot and on link loss / watchdog timeout.

g.desc: Firmware must keep motors disabled at boot and on link loss / watchdog timeout.

g.text: 1S LiPo only: 4.2V maximum. Do not connect a 2S battery.

g.desc: 1S LiPo only: 4.2V maximum. Do not connect a 2S battery.

g.text: C101-C104 are installed at the motor terminals, not on this PCB.

g.desc: C101-C104 are installed at the motor terminals, not on this PCB.

g.text: Verify motor startup/stall current, regulator transients and actual camera flex before fabrication.

g.desc: Verify motor startup/stall current, regulator transients and actual camera flex before fabrication.

g.text: No on-board charging. External charger required. Disconnect battery after use.
